Name: Herod Antipas
Summary: Herod Antipas, son of Herod the Great, ruled Galilee and Perea. He imprisoned and beheaded John the Baptist, heard reports of Jesus and hoped to see a sign, and joined Pilate's mockery of Jesus at the trial.
KeyStory: Antipas beheaded John to keep a rash oath, then met Jesus in silence when the prisoner would not perform.
LifeLesson: Curiosity is not repentance. Antipas wanted a miracle from Jesus and got silence, because he had already silenced the prophet.
